scenes.narration: In Linköping, researchers looked for em-ex-eens: sheets of metal and carbon or nitrogen, just a few atomic layers thick. They were discovered in twenty eleven.

scenes.narration: The artificial intelligence scanned crystallographic databases and found thirty-three em-ex-eens already synthesized but not recognized as such by the scientific community.

scenes.narration: Inspired by those findings, they created eleven new ones. Some use rare earths like praseodymium or neodymium and can be magnetic, widening the possibilities.
